ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B3-2,
Community Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 26-F in the

area bound by:

South Emerald Avenue; the alley next north of and parallel to West 4141" Street; South
Union Avenue; and West 111" Street,

to those of a B2-2, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shail be effective after its passage and publication.
